title: Omni Tool
body:
# Omni Tool – Break the Limits of Enchantments

**Tired of vanilla enchantment restrictions?**

Omni Tool gives you full control over how enchantments behave — powerful, flexible, and designed for **both servers and clients**.

# 🚀 Why Omni Tool?
## ⚡ No More Enchantment Conflicts
- Combine enchantments that were never meant to work together to create the one and only Tool you need.

**🎛️ Smart Toggle System**
- Enable, disable, and customize enchantments on the fly.

**🎚️ Adjust Levels Freely
- Fine-tune enchantment levels exactly the way you want.

## 🌐 Built for Everyone

**🖥️ Client Mod? Optional.**
- Full functionality even without installing anything client-side.

**🧩 Seamless Polymer Integration**
- Players without the mod can access everything via an intuitive GUI (Shift + F).

**⌨️ Quick Access**
- Open the Custom interface instantly with a keybind (default: X) on the client.

## ⚙️ Advanced Customization

**🔓 Override Conflict Groups**
- Choose which enchantments can coexist — even normally incompatible ones.

**🛑 Control Curse Behavior**
- Prevent curses from being disabled (or change it if you want).

**🔄 Live Reloading**
- Apply config changes instantly with /reloadomnitool.

**💡 Built for Servers**
- Omni Tool is designed with server performance and flexibility in mind:

**Works fully server-side
No extra Polymer ports required
Custom Reload permission (omnitool.reload)**

 **Take full control of enchantments.**
 **Play your way! Break the rules!**
